arguments.name: Animation Vocabulary
arguments.description: Check-tier gate on the blocking/poses, review and evidence steps (D96, D81): every intent word a step writes is a term of the controlled direction vocabulary. The probe reads the vocabulary and the film's overrides, then the intent words of every proposal file, the because clause of every ruling written in the ruling form, the breakdown kinds and key intents of the pose sheets and the intents of the material contract, and refuses a word that is not a vocabulary term or a film alias. A proposal, ruling, pose sheet or material that says 'vibey' fails the gate until the word is replaced by the term that says what was meant.
arguments.subject: animation-vocabulary
arguments.guidance: Ground truth by exit code (D81, D96). The probe runs `python3 scripts/animation/probe-vocabulary.py v3/vocabulary.json --overrides v3/vocabulary-overrides.json` in the renderer root: it reads the vocabulary and the film's overrides, then the `intent`, `options` and `default` of every file under v3/proposals/, the because clause of every ruling in the ruling form in v3/rulings.json (parsed by scripts/animation/rulings.mjs; older free prose is not checked), the breakdown kinds and key intents of v3/poses/ and every `intent` in v3/materials.json, and refuses a word that is not a term. Its first line is its control (a proposal with intent 'vibey', a ruling 'because vibey', a material intent 'bouncy', a breakdown kind 'wobbly', a facet word 'zany', an owner-ask with no default, an alias to a term that is not there and a vocabulary without 'whip' are each refused, and a clean fixture of each kind is accepted) and it refuses to report if a control does not trip. On FAIL quote the probe's refused line, open the file and field it names and replace the refused word with the vocabulary term that says what was meant (the term's definition and the lane or property it governs are in the vocabulary file); if no term says it, file an owner-ask proposal for a new term and keep the old word out of every file until it is ruled. Never edit the vocabulary, the overrides, the probe or this check to make it pass. Control: a proposal with intent 'vibey' is refused.
